text: - **CI Python scripts:** unit-tested with `python3 -m unittest discover -s .github/scripts` as the fast `ci-scripts` leg — 100 tests in seven test files (§4; 94 until 2026-10-15-cold-agent-test, whose test_cold_agent.py went 27 → 33 as `ColdAgentStubTest` retired with the stub; 79 in six until 2026-10-14-quality-gates, which added test_coverage_floor.py's 7, 5 leg cases and 3 install cases; 78 until 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, whose upstream merge added one to test_wpt_area_changes.py), among them the eight contract tests (five until 2026-10-14-quality-gates) of the CI install script `.github/scripts/apt-install.sh` (`InstallScriptTest`), the seven of `CoverageFloorTest`, which pin the coverage floor script `.github/scripts/coverage_floor.py` (.github/scripts/test_coverage_floor.py:17-88), the one test of `BlitzTestsTargetsTest`, which pins the blitz-tests manifest to one test target per file with upstream's `all` target unbuilt (.github/scripts/test_blitz_tests_targets.py:17-26), and the workflow invariant that every package install of ci.yml is bounded — the job first ensuring PyYAML by a guarded step, `python3 -c 'import yaml' || bash .github/scripts/apt-install.sh python3-yaml` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:186-199; .github/workflows/ci.yml:191; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:218-235; .github/scripts/test_ci_workflows.py:378-492; .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:27)

text: - **blitz-dom (node):** in-file tests cover overlay scrollbar opacity, text-input scrolling, and the element state of the `disabled` attribute (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/scrollbar.rs:224-237; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/element.rs:1071-1205; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:2078-2164) and, since 2026-10-13-range-input-interaction, the range value rules — `node/range.rs` holds 7 inline tests over stated tables: the HTML floating-point parser (20 rows), the four attributes read as bounds, step and base (9), a `value` attribute seeding a finite, bounded, on-grid value (12), moves stepping, jumping and placing on the grid (9), degenerate attributes keeping the value finite, bounded and on the grid (8), a decimal step writing its decimals, and a re-seed and a re-sanitize following the attributes (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/range.rs:303-529); `node/select.rs` holds 4 inline table tests of the select's rules — the selectedness setting algorithm keeping one chosen option, a step skipping disabled options and stopping at the ends, typed text matching the first enabled label it starts, text stripped and collapsed (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/select.rs:195-301); `Node::out_of_flow` with `Node::record_out_of_flow` and `style_is_out_of_flow`, and `ElementData::classes` with `parse_classes`, have no unit test of their own, read through `incremental_oracle`, `paint_tree_incremental`, `paint_order`, the blitz-dom lib tests and every stand check in both layout modes
